name: PrimaryNav - Communities Derived
description: The Communities dropdown pinned open for capture. WhatsApp is the hand-authored link an editor keeps in nav.json; AI and Founders below it are generated from the communities collection at render time and sorted alphabetically. This is the asymmetry with Chapters: that group is injected whole by the layout, while this one already belongs to an editor, so the derived items join its children rather than replacing them. Publishing a third community would appear here with no nav edit at all. The panel is pinned by the isolation route rather than a scenario interaction, because a hover or click does not survive the screenshot on this route and would capture the resting, closed menu.
